subject: Updates in development version of Shiny

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Updates in development version of Shiny
parts:
Hi everyone -

We're nearing the next release of Shiny, version 0.10.2. In addition to the usual bug fixes, this version includes some new features:
* Single-file apps are now supported. Instead of server.R and ui.R, you can create a single file, app.R, that contains both components.
* Progress bars can now be displayed
* Data Tables has been updated from version 1.9.4 to 1.10.2.

The following articles describe how to use single-file apps, and progress indicators. They're on RPubs for now, but will be moved to the Shiny dev center site when 0.10.2 is released on CRAN.
  Single-file apps: http://rpubs.com/wch/28352
  Global progress indicators: http://rpubs.com/wch/28353

We'd appreciate any feedback about these features the development version. You can install the latest version using devtools:
  devtools::install_github("shiny/rstudio")

Thanks!
-Winston Chang
RStudio
